summary: Solo hiker on Sentinel Point (12er on the back side of Pikes Peak) slipped on the established trail just below treeline, fell and tripped again, dislocating her foot; she called 911 with GPS coordinates. Divide Fire reached her first, then Teller County SAR; litter carry down the mountain, ATV transfer at Horsethief Park, then ambulance to Memorial Hospital. ER found a broken tibia and fibula; tibia surgically repaired two days later.
responding_agency: Teller County SAR; Divide Fire Protection District; Flight for Life Colorado
notes: Date inferred: subject's account written for First Responders Day (Oct 28) at ~10.5 weeks post-injury -> 2021-08-15. Third place, CSAR 2022 blog contest non-SAR member mission story.
